newsitem.title: USA: Vencor antitrust review period extended.
newsitem.headline: Vencor antitrust review period extended.

text.p: Vencor Inc said Thursday the U.S. Department of Justice has asked for more information regarding its offer to acquire Transitional Hospitals Corp.

Accordingly, the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust review period, originally to expire Thursday, has been extended until 10 days after Vencor complies with the request for more information.
Vencor said it will work as expeditiously as possible to provide the information required.

"Vencor continues to believe that the acquisition of Transitional raises no antitrust issues in the highly competitive market for acute care medical services and remains hopeful that the tender offer will be completed by mid-June," the company said in a statement Thursday evening.
Vencor made its $16 a share offer for Transitional Hospitals May 7.
